title: Add Command Palette
content: Create command palette (Cmd+K style). Trigger: Cmd/Ctrl+K keyboard shortcut. Modal: fixed inset-0 z-50 with backdrop blur. Container: max-w-lg mx-auto mt-20 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden. Search input: w-full px-4 py-3 text-lg border-b focus:outline-none, autofocus on open. Results: max-h-96 overflow-y-auto. Result item: px-4 py-2 hover:bg-gray-100 cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-3. Active item: bg-blue-50 border-l-2 border-blue-500. Keyboard nav: up/down arrows, Enter to select, Escape to close.

variants.simple: Create keyboard-accessible command palette with search.
variants.detailed: Create command palette (Cmd+K style). Trigger: Cmd/Ctrl+K keyboard shortcut. Modal: fixed inset-0 z-50 with backdrop blur. Container: max-w-lg mx-auto mt-20 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xl overflow-hidden. Search input: w-full px-4 py-3 text-lg border-b focus:outline-none, autofocus on open. Results: max-h-96 overflow-y-auto. Result item: px-4 py-2 hover:bg-gray-100 cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-3. Active item: bg-blue-50 border-l-2 border-blue-500. Keyboard nav: up/down arrows, Enter to select, Escape to close.
variants.advanced: Create advanced command palette with categories and recent items. Trigger: useEffect for keydown listener, Cmd/Ctrl+K opens, prevent default browser behavior. Modal: createPortal to body, AnimatePresence for mount/unmount animation. Backdrop: fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm, click to close. Container: transform animation (scale and opacity). Search: input with placeholder "Type a command or search...", clear button on right, loading spinner when searching. Results structure: grouped by category (Navigation, Actions, Recent). Category header: px-4 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase sticky top-0 bg-white. Result item: flex items-center gap-3, icon on left, title and description, keyboard shortcut badge on right (kbd styling). Keyboard navigation: useRef for active index, scroll into view for active item. Search logic: fuzzy search with highlighting of matched characters. Recent items: stored in localStorage, shown when input empty. No results: helpful message with suggestions. Actions: each command has action callback, close palette after action. Nested commands: some items open sub-menus (e.g., "Go to..." shows page list). Footer: keyboard hints "↑↓ Navigate • Enter Select • Esc Close".

author: Ersin KOÇ
